message.subject: PRINTING United booth idea
message.body:
Hi [Name],

Saw you're building an 80s arcade experience for PRINTING United in October—love the creative approach to standing out.

Quick thought: we work with several substrate manufacturers who use our protective films as live booth demos. Watching spray paint wipe clean off graphics or seeing UV resistance tests in real-time tends to stop people in their aisles. Could be a natural fit with your experiential setup.

If you're still locking down booth content, happy to send over what others have done. No pressure either way.

Best,
[Your name]

personalization_used.hook: PRINTING United Expo 2025 with 80s arcade-themed booth investment
